enumeration_note: Two distinct entry triggers share the one ORB skeleton: (0) enter WITH the breakout of the opening range, vs (1) wait for the breakout then enter on the PULLBACK to the pullback level â€” genuinely different entry logic, so split per the under-split rule (not opposition â€” both trade the breakout direction). The 5/15/30-minute opening ranges are timeframe variants within each. This is an onboarding 'video 1' concept/terminology intro; the breakout setup is taught concretely (entry + half-range stop + half/full-range targets), the pullback setup is named as 'a full strategy built inside of the platform' with a described pullback-to-level entry but only gestural exits.

coaching_notes: combing thousands of stocks across dozens of strategies leads to overwhelm and jumping from stock to stock, strategy to strategy
understanding the psychology of these breakouts really can help you transform your trading
the range high is where sellers stepped in with conviction; range low where buyers defended with strength
element_inventory: PRECONDITION: opening range must form first â€” high and low of the first 5/15/30 minutes after the 9:30 ET open
ENTRY (long): price breaks a penny above the opening range high
ENTRY (short): price breaks below the opening range low
RANGE VALUE: opening range high minus opening range low (e.g. $1.03 in the S&P example)
STOP: half-range stop, placed below the half-range mark (range value / 2)
TP1: half-range target = opening range high + (range value / 2) (e.g. +$0.52)
TP2: full-range target = opening range high + full range value
VARIANT SUB-MECHANIC: 5-min OB = 9:30-9:35 ET opening range
VARIANT SUB-MECHANIC: 15-min OB = 9:30-9:45 ET opening range
VARIANT SUB-MECHANIC: 30-min OB = 9:30-10:00 ET opening range
TIMING: setups sought throughout the entire trading day, not just the first 30 minutes
strategies.entry_summary: After the opening range forms from the first 5, 15, or 30 minutes of the RTH session (starting 9:30 ET), enter in the direction of the breakout â€” long when price breaks a penny above the opening range high, short when price breaks below the opening range low.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop placed below the half-range mark (half-range stop). Profit targets projected from the range value: half-range target (opening range high/low Â± half of the range value) and full-range target (Â± the full range value).
strategies.name: opening_range_breakout

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: breakout above ORH / below ORL of the 5-min range
variants.target_note: half-range and full-range targets off the 5-min range value
variants.transcript_quote: The 5m minute OB takes place from 9:30 a.m. Eastern to 9:35 a.m. Eastern.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: breakout above ORH / below ORL of the 15-min range
variants.target_note: half-range and full-range targets off the 15-min range value
variants.transcript_quote: The 15-minute is the first 15 minutes of the market. So, from 9:30 to now 9:45.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: breakout above ORH / below ORL of the 30-min range
variants.target_note: half-range and full-range targets off the 30-min range value
variants.transcript_quote: And the 30 minute is from 9:30 to 10 a.m. Eastern.

element_inventory: PRECONDITION: the initial breakout must have already occurred
ENTRY: price pulls back to the pullback level, then enter back toward the long mark
PULLBACK LEVEL: opening range high minus the half-range value (range value / 2)
VARIANT SUB-MECHANIC: same 5-min / 15-min / 30-min opening ranges define the pullback level
strategies.entry_summary: After the initial breakout takes place, wait for price to pull back to the pullback level (opening range high minus the half-range value), then enter in the breakout direction back toward the long mark.
strategies.exit_summary: Gestural â€” entry aims 'back towards the long mark' after the pullback; explicit stop/target for the pullback leg not stated (platform-defined, presumably the same half-range/full-range structure).
strategies.name: opening_range_pullback

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to retrace to the pullback level rather than entering the raw breakout
variants.target_note: entry toward the long mark; targets not explicitly stated for the pullback leg
variants.transcript_quote: the initial breakout took place and in this case price pulled back and then we're looking for an entry back towards the long mark
variants.variant_label: pullback to the pullback level after breakout
